rows.body_text: The illustration shows a circle. At the center of the circle is a smaller circle that reads, Persuasion. Wedges around the small circle, Persuasion form the larger circle. The wedges read as follows: • Unity (Icon of a group of four people with joined hands): People are motivated by their feelings or belonging. • Scarcity (Icon of a diamond): People want what is rare. • Authority (Icon of a hammer): Expertise and credibility promote trust. • Consensus (Icon of a group of three people): People want to align with their social group. • Liking (Icon of a thumbs-up): People are more persuaded by others they like or relate to. • Reciprocity (Icon of shaking hands): Give and you are more likely to receive. • Consistency (Icon of a calendar): People like to stay true to their values and commitments.
